question: How should Revision 2 handle a missing approved renderer when no atomic renderer-bootstrap capability exists?
rationale: Do not invent or widen a capability during Recipe repair. Stage 15 selects an existing narrow atomic owner when one exists; otherwise it returns blocked. A new generic renderer-bootstrap capability would require reopening Phase 2–7 taxonomy, provenance, permissions, cases, and evaluation.
implications: The renderer holdout is revised to expect fail-closed behavior when no authorized setup owner exists.
Stage 15 cannot install or upgrade an unowned renderer.
Existing test-runtime-bootstrap, tool-runtime-readiness, workflow-runtime-upgrade, and document-rendering-and-validation boundaries remain unchanged.
No atomic Skill is added or widened.
